note: Feature flags for HUD code that is written but not part of the base game. hiding: Orb removed hiding from the base game and holds it for a future stealth-specialist fighter (docs/ep/vision.md). With it off the HUD ignores the hidden state and the lost-trail cue everywhere (plate chips, the eye-slash marker, the strip's ping and last-seen mark, the silhouette's fading); the code stays for that fighter. Turn it on in a fighter's data when that fighter exists. touch_full and remap: the Settings screen lists the Full touch layout and the Remap controls entry, dimmed and marked Soon, until Controls' touch-full layout and the remap screen exist; both are on now. about_music and about_voice: the About page's two sentences that are true only once they are (the music was generated with Suno; there is no voice acting) are shown only while their flag is on; both are off until the music ships and Orb confirms the voice sentence (docs/legal/go-to-market.md section 1). A page item whose icon is named about_music or about_voice is that sentence. three_strengths: the martial face buttons are X light, Y medium, B heavy and the signature is the power button held with B (docs/design/brawl-second-pass.md, docs/ui/hud-spec.md section 48); flipped with Encounter's slice C2a, and with it the legend, the Full touch words, the Remap and How to play words, the weight mark's third value and the latched-charge and charges-off settings follow. reduce_flashing: the Reduce flashing setting row and the flashing notice's reworded line (VFX's register); on when Legal has approved the words.
